notes.title: Patch 1.13.5
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! Our first patch is here:

- Fixed a soft lock in Chapter 6 (you could stay trapped on the small island)
- Various Translations fixes/improvements

We'd appreciate if you could leave a review for the game so that it will help get the ball rolling, thank you so much! Counting on you folks!

Cheers

notes.title: Updated DEMO - New languages and Features! Please review!
notes.content:
Hey all, hope you are preparing for a grand sci-fi mystery on 25th of September!

In view of the release of the game, we have released a new update to the demo which, streamlines the experience with the full release, so you see what you really get with the full game:

- French, Italian, German and Spanish Translations
- Added options screen (adjust vol levels, text skipping etc)
- More savegames
- Double click for faster exits
- Fixed VOs
- Optimized game size

Now the demo has a separate page and you can also leave a review as per Steam's latest update! So if you enjoy it, please leave one, it would help us alot!

See you soon at the Station!
